subject: Narrowstairs Systems — architecture walk-through window & scheduling
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@narrowstairs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Narrowstairs Systems — architecture walk-through window & scheduling

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday. The team found the workload profile and questions very helpful. We'd like to schedule a focused architecture walk-through that covers: model topology, KV cache behavior for your long-context flows, network egress patterns for private deployment, and a short SLO/cost tradeoff section.

Proposed 60–90 minute windows (PT):
- Tue 15 Sep — 10:00–11:30
- Wed 16 Sep — 14:00–15:30
- Thu 17 Sep — 09:00–10:30

Attached: redwood-narrowstairs-architecture-agenda.pdf (high-level agenda) and pre-demo-checklist.md (env / firewall items we usually validate). Can you confirm which slot works best, and whether you want us to include anyone from your network/security team?

If none of those work, tell us a few times that do and we’ll try to accommodate. Ben (CC) will run the walkthrough content and Vivek (CC) will cover deployment/topology tradeoffs.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: redwood-narrowstairs-architecture-agenda.pdf, pre-demo-checklist.md
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@narrowstairs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Lee <michael.lee@narrowstairs.com>, security@narrowstairs.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Narrowstairs Systems — architecture walk-through window & scheduling

Kimberly —

Appreciate the follow-up and the agenda. The Wed 16 Sep 14:00–15:30 PT slot works best for our engineering leads, but I need to loop in our network lead (security@narrowstairs.com) — they asked if we could push the session by a day to Thu 17 Sep due to a conflict with a compliance review.

If you can do Thu 17 Sep 09:00–10:30 PT that would solve the conflict on our side. Also, can you include a short section on your private deployment options (VPC routing + KMS integration)? Michael Lee (CC) will attend and is our infra owner.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Director of Platform Engineering — Narrowstairs Systems
daniel.park@narrowstairs.com

Subject: Re: Narrowstairs Systems — architecture walk-through window & scheduling

Thanks for the quick reply — Thu 17 Sep 09:00–10:30 PT is fine on our side. We’ll make sure to allocate 20 minutes to VPC/KMS integration and traffic egress patterns for private deployments (Vivek will lead that section).

Ben — can you add the network checklist items from the pre-demo doc into the shared Drive folder and confirm whether we should request any temporary firewall rules ahead of time?

Daniel / Michael / security team — I’ll send a calendar invite with video link + agenda and include the short pre-demo checklist in the invite so your network folks can review before the session. If you want, Ben can run a 15-minute environment/port check 48 hours prior.

Best,
Kimberly

All —

Confirmed for Thu 17 Sep 09:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite with join link sent ("Redwood — Narrowstairs architecture session"). I added a short 15-minute "ports & access" pre-check appointment for Tue 15 Sep 10:30 PT — optional but recommended for your infra team.

Quick note on content: I’ll demo a short live run of the KV cache behavior with a 32k context trace and a sample routing policy, then Vivek will discuss VPC/KMS integration patterns and options for private deployments.

If security wants us to redact any internal hostnames from the demo traces just let me know before the pre-check.
